programme.title: Plavuša, film
programme.desc: Katie Gregerstitch (Jessica Simpson) ljepotica je iz malog mjesta u Oklahomi, koja je došla u New York u posjet svojem dugogodišnjem dečku. Kada ga nađe u zagrljaju druge žene, Katie je jako povrijeđena. Nakon prvotnog šoka, Katie ga odluči ostaviti i ponovno pronaći samu sebe. Uz pomoć kolega Freddya (Andy Dick) i Debre (Penelope Ann Miller), dobiva posao u najvećoj građevinskoj tvrtki, gdje upoznaje Bena (Luke Willson). Katie se s vremenom počinje zaljubljivati u svog kolegu, koji skriva veliku tajnu. Sada ništa više neće spriječiti ovu upornu djevojku da dobije ono što njezino srce želi. Katie tada postaje primjer kako je bistru, lijepu djevojku s juga jednostavno nemoguće obuzdati u namjeri da pronađe sreću

programme.title: Ta luda vjenčanja 3, film
programme.desc: Claude i Marie Verneuil uskoro će proslaviti 40. godišnjicu braka. Za tu su priliku njihove četiri kćeri - Isabelle, Odile, Ségolène i Laure - odlučile organizirati veliku zabavu iznenađenja u njihovoj obiteljskoj kući u Chinonu. Claude i Marie još uvijek teško podnose brakove svojih kćeri s muškarcima različitog porijekla i vjere pa im poziv i svih njihovih roditelja na obiteljsku zabavu nije baš najbolje sjelo.

programme.title: Ta luda vjenčanja 3, film

programme.title: Dobra djeca, film
programme.desc: Četiri srednjoškolca shvate da su pogriješili što su preskočili neka iskustva koja su tipična za njihovu dob. Odluče dati sve od sebe kako ih više ne bi smatrali 'dobrom djecom'. Posve promijene svoje ponašanje i odluče malo se zabaviti prije nego se najesen rastanu i krenu na fakultet.

programme.title: Van Wilder 3, film
programme.desc: Otkrijte kako je apsolvent Van Wilder zaradio svoj vragolasti ugled u ovom prednastavku koji detaljno opisuje njegove vragolije s brucoške godine koje su ušle u povijest. Kad se Van Wilder (Jonathan Bennett) upisao na Sveučilište Coolidge, nije imao pojma da će biti tako zastrašujuća zadaća ići stopama svog imućnog oca. Strogi dekan službeno je zabranio zabave u kampusu, a studentsko je tijelo previše zauzeto učenjem da bi se borilo protiv toga. Kad Van Wilder otkrije da su sve studentice u kampusu dale zavjet čednosti, on objavljuje da nijedna navijačica neće ostati nedirnuta i nijedna bačva piva neće ostati zatvorena. No neće biti lako osloboditi Sveučilište Coolidge od ugnjetavačkih okova, progona zabava i seksualne slabosti. Da bi ostvario svoju misiju, Van Wilder morat će napraviti pauzu s učenjem te osloboditi ozbiljnu nestašnost.

programme.title: Paučina, film
programme.desc: Osmogodišnjeg Petera muči tajanstveno, stalno kucanje unutar zida njegove spavaće sobe - kuckanje za koje njegovi roditelji inzistiraju da je samo u njegovoj mašti. Kako se Peterov strah pojačava, on vjeruje da bi njegovi roditelji mogli skrivati strašnu, opasnu tajnu i dovodi u pitanje njihovo povjerenje. A za dijete, što može biti strašnije od toga?

programme.title: Crna Dalija, film
programme.desc: Dvojica losanđeleskih policajaca, Dwight "Bucky" Bleichert (J. Hartnett) i Lee Blanchard (A. Eckhart), istražuju slučaj nedavnog umorstva Elizabeth Short (M. Kirshner), mlade glumice u usponu koju je nepoznati počinitelj izmasakrirao do neprepoznatljivosti. Kako istraga napreduje, Dwight se zaljubi u Leejevu djevojku Kay (S. Johansson), dok je Lee sve više opsjednut slučajem. Uskoro Lee upozna neobičnu djevojku Madeleine (H. Swank) koja je jako slična žrtvi. Između njih bi se mogla razviti ljubavna veza, što bi moglo zakomplicirati istragu, tim više što djevojka djeluje čudno, kao uostalom i njezina obitelj... "Crna dalija" potresan je detektivski film nastao prema izuzetno uspjelom i hvaljenom romanu Jamesa Ellroyja (prema jednom od njegovih romana snimljen je i film L. A. Povjeriljivo te još nekoliko njih). Pesimistična je to i intrigantna priča utemeljena na istinitom slučaju stravična umorstva mlade američke starlete Elizabeth Short, evidentno djela patološkog ubojice čiji detalji do danas nisu do kraja istraženi. Takav slučaj svojedobno je odjeknuo u medijima, a po njemu je već napravljeno nekoliko literarnih i filmskih adaptacija. Ovaj film potpisuje poznati američki redatelj Brian De Palma (umjesto prvotne namjere da režiju preuzme David Fincher), koji je u svojoj karijeri snimio cijenjene kriminalističke filmove (Lice s ožiljkom, Nedodirljivi i druge). U glavnim ulogama nastupaju poznati američki glumci A. Eckhart, S. Johansson i H. Swank.

programme.title: Različita, film
programme.desc: Film je nastao na temelju bestselera Veronice Roth i smješten je u svijet u kojem su ljudi podijeljeni u pet skupina, s obzirom na prevladavajuće osobine svojih ličnosti. Tris (Shailene Woodley) je rođena u skupini koja se bori protiv taštine, napadne odjeće, bilo čega čime bi se pojedinac isticao. Svakome od pripadnika te skupine važan je drugi čovjek. No Tris osjeća da ne pripada toj grupi jer ne razmišlja uvijek o drugima. Svaki građanin sa 16 g. mora proći testiranje kojim se određuje kojoj bi grupi najbolje pripadao, no za Tris se iz njenog testiranja nije mogao izvući konačni zaključak pa je sama morala donijeti odluku. To je opasna odluka jer se Tris ne uklapa ni u jednu grupu, ona je različita i to mora sakriti. Kada otkrije urotu kojoj je cilj uništiti sve različite, a koju predvodi Jeanine Matthews (Kate Winslet), Tris će morati uz pomoć Foura (Theo James) otkriti što ih čini toliko različitima da su opasni.

programme.title: Trilogija Različita: Pobunjena, film
programme.desc: Nakon što je otkrila da ne pripada niti jednoj frakciji, Beatrice Prior mora izabrati svoj daljnji život. Rastrgana između društvenih pravila i vlastitog puta kojeg smatra jedino ispravnim ona će pokazati da biti različita nije više mana, nego najveća prednost.

programme.title: Trilogija Različita: Odana, film
programme.desc: Što ako je cijeli tvoj svijet bio laž? Što ako samo jedno otkriće, baš kao i samo jedna odluka, može promijeniti sve? Što ako ćeš zbog ljubavi i odanosti napraviti neočekivane stvari? Nakon što je društvo u koje je vjerovala uništeno nasiljem i željom za moći, Tris se zajedno s Tobiasom odlučuje otići i istražiti granice svijeta koji ne poznaje. No, nova otkrića i istine koje izlaze na vidjelo ponovno će zahtijevati od Tris da se suoči s nepredvidljivošću ljudske prirode, ali i sa samom sobom. Istovremeno, i Tris i Tobias moraju se suočiti s činjenicom da se njihov položaj u društvu promijenio, te oni koji su bili privilegirani to više nisu.

programme.title: Spark: Svemirska pustolovina, film
programme.desc: Prije 13 g., ljuti gen. Zhong preuzeo je nadzor na planetom Bana i uništio ga. Vlada željeznom šakom. Tu su još i Spark, majmun tinejdžer i njegovi prijatelji, Vix, lisica spremna na borbu, i Chuck, prasac koji se razumije u tehniku. Spark shvati da Zhong ima tajni plan da preuzme svemir ako uhvati ogromno svemirsko čudovište znano kao Kraken - zvijer koja ima moć stvaranja crnih rupa. Ako Zhong dobije Krakenovu moć, imat će najsmrtnosnije oružje u povijesti, i sad je sve na Sparku i njegovim prijateljima. Moraju ga spriječiti u toj namjeri.

programme.title: Majstori iluzije, film
programme.desc: Četiri talentirana mađioničara: iluzionist J. Daniel Atlas (Jesse Eisenberg), mentalist Merrit McKinney (Woddy Harrelson), koji pokušava ponovo stati na noge nakon što je njegov brat i menadžer zbrisao s njegovim parama, stručnjakinja za bijeg i Dannyjeva pomoćnica/ljubavnica Henley Reeves (Isla Fisher) te stručnjak za obijanje brava Jack Wider (Dave Franco) dobiju poziv za okupljanje nepoznatog „dobročinitelja.

programme.title: Majstori iluzije 2, film
programme.desc: Godinu dana nakon što su nadmudrili FBI i dodvorili se javnosti svojim Robin Hood stilom, iluzionisti se pripremaju za veliki povratak na scenu. Vraćaju se kako bi razotkrili neetičku praksu tehnološkog magnata koji ih je primorao na pljačku. Njihova jedina nada je izvesti još jedan spektakularan trik kojim će otkriti tko zapravo stoji iza cijele priče.

programme.title: Lov na ubojicu, film
programme.desc: Radnja tako prati Eleanor Falco, policajku koja se nađe u opasnoj situaciji kad nepoznati snajperist s visoke zgrade nasumično počne pucati na prolaznike. Kad FBI-jev agent Geoffrey Lammark stigne na mjesto zločina istražiti što se dogodilo, uočit će nešto posebno u vezi s Eleanor te je pozvati da im pomogne uhvatiti ubojicu.

programme.title: Hotel Artemis, film
programme.desc: Debitantski film scenarista i redatelja Drewa Pearcea u kojem glumi impresivna zvjezdana glumačka postava: Jodie Foster, Sterling K. Brown, Jenny Slate, Charlie Day, Zachary Quinto, Sofia Boutella, Dave Bautista i Jeff Goldblum. Srijeda je navečer 2028. godine, a ulice u centru Los Angelesa su neprohodne. Treću noć najstrašnije pobune u povijesti L.A., privatizirana policija tuče plave, ratno obojene prosvjednike, čiji je jedini zahtjev čista voda. Usred ovog kaosa, četvorica muškaraca s maskama lubanje nalaze se usred neuspjele pljačke banke. Sherman Atkins vodi svog brata i njihova dva pomagača iz banke u vatrenu borbu s policajcima. Ozlijeđene i bez druge mogućnosti, Sherman ih vodi do njihove jedine nade za spas ... HOTELA ARTEMIS. Svojevrsnoj ilegalnoj bolnici za kriminalce u kojoj vrijede posebna pravila.

programme.title: Spas od zla, film
programme.desc: Narednik Rick Pedroni, nakon službe u Afganistanu, kući se vraća promijenjen i opasan. Na položaju je doživio napad tajanstvene sile. Dok mu ne priznaju PTSP i naručuju psiho terapiju, Rickova supruga Kate otkriva da je njezin muž opsjednut zlim duhom. Kate se mora utrkivati s vremenom kako bi razotkrila istinu i spasila svoga muža od zle sile.

programme.title: Grad mrtvaca, film
programme.desc: Vladin pokus je vani, pušten je mutirani genetski virus koji povećava i poboljšava ljudske sposobnosti. Čovječanstvo je postalo jače, brže, smrtonosnije. Kao novi ubojiti stroj. Podiže se vojska inficiranih. I kreće borba protiv infekcije za koju znaju da je ne mogu istrijebiti. U ovaj pakao ulaze njih osmorica posebno pripremljeni, obučeni, osebujnoga borbenoga stila. Moraju spasiti znanstvenika čiji pokusi možda imaju ključ za spašavanje čovječanstva. No to moraju odraditi u dijelu grada koji je stavljen pod karantenu. Hoće li uspjeti?

programme.title: Beskrajni Božić, TV film
programme.desc: Srednje dijete koje nikoga ne zanima neočekivano se nađe u središtu zanimanja kad shvati da mu se užasan obiteljski Božić stalno ponavlja. Kao jedini kojemu se dan ponavlja ‘iz dana u dan’, odluči iskoristiti svoj jedinstveni dar kako bi malo promijenio blagdane i svojoj obitelji pripremio Božić koji nikad neće zaboraviti.

programme.title: Nacrt, film
programme.desc: Mladi Moskovljanin Kiril vrlo je talentirani stručnjak za IT i videoigre. Njegov je život savršen: roditelji ga vole, ima dobro plaćeni posao, lijepu djevojku... Sve dok ga jednog dana odjednom ne izbrišu iz svačijeg sjećanja i zaborave ga svi koje je poznavao. Tražeći objašnjenje, Kiril otkrije da je izabran za vrlo važnu i tajnu misiju, njegova je svrha postati čuvar vrata između paralelnih svjetova, a njih je na desetke u svemiru. Može li Kiril riješiti zagonetku paralelnih svjetova, saznati tko je glavni um iza misije čiji je on sada ključni dio i vratiti svoj život? Ili je možda svijet u kojem živimo samo imaginarni nacrt koji zapravo ne postoji?!

programme.title: Alex Cross, film
programme.desc: Nova ekranizacija romana najplaćenijeg pisca na svijetu, Jamesa Pattersona, o policijskom psihologu Alexu Crossu. Film donosi priču o policijskom psihologu Alexu Cross-u koji istražuje jeziva ubojstva serijskog ubojice Michaela Sullivana aka The Butchera. Međutim sukob postaje osoban i Alex Cross a je gurnut na rub vlastitih moralnih i psiholoških granica...

programme.title: Bježi, film
programme.desc: Nešto je zlokobno i neprirodno u odnosu majke Diane (Sarah Paulson) i kćeri Chloe (Kiera Allen). Prezaštitnički nastrojena Diane je od rođenja odgajala kćer u potpunoj izolaciji od svijeta. Kad Chloe odraste i postane mlada žena, počinje otkrivati da stvari u njihovoj kući nisu onakvima kakvima se čine. Postaje jasno da je veza Diane s kćeri neprirodna jer je cijelo vrijeme pokušava spriječiti da živi vlastitim životom - u biti je drži kao zarobljenicu u vlastitom domu. Chloe polako otkriva sve više tajni o svojoj „brižnoj majci, a opasna igra živaca tek počinje…

programme.title: Bull, film
programme.desc: Ovo je brutalan, razoran i vraški napet, osvetnički triler scenarista i redatelja Paula Andrewa Williamsa. Nakon 10 g. izbivanja, Bull se vraća na stara mjesta da nađe nestalog sina i želi se osvetiti onima koji su ga prevarili i ostavili da umre. Uz otkrivanje bolnih tajni iz prošlosti, Bull kao opsjednut čovjek ne preza ni pred čim kako bi uzvratio onima koji se moraju iskupiti za svoje grijehe.

programme.title: Pali anđeo, serija
programme.desc: Osuđena za zločin koji nije počinila i koju progone tajanstvene Sjene, Lucindu Price šalju u izoliranu i neobičnu popravnu ustanovu Mač i križ. Upoznaje privlačnog Daniela koji je uvjeren da ju je poznavao otprije, i ćudljivog, dosjetljivog Cama koji ustraje doznati 'pravi' razlog zbog kojega je onamo poslana. Uznemirena okruženjem, osobljem i sustanarima, Luce misli da ludi i pokušava pobjeći.

programme.title: Leatherface: Početak, film
programme.desc: Film Teksaški masakr motornom pilom je 1974. godine šokirao svijet. Sada je došao trenutak da se ispriča priča o jednom od najkultnijih zlih likova u povijesti kinematografije. U ovom filmu koji prethodi radnji filma Teksaški masakr motornom pilom, mladu medicinsku sestru otimaju četiri nasilna tinejdžera koji su pobjegli iz psihijatrijske ustanove i vode je na put iz pakla. Jedan od njih je osuđen na život prepun tragedija i strahota koje će mu uništiti zdrav razum i pretvoriti ga u čudovište po imenu LEATHERFACE, a progoni ga poremećeni predstavnik zakona željan osvete. Film režiraju Alexandre Bustillo i Julien Maury, a u glavnim ulogama su Lili Taylor koja je preuzela ulogu majke mladog Leatherfacea, Stephen Dorff u ulozi ludog policajca, Jessica Madsen, James Bloor, Sam Strike i Sam Coleman su u ulogama ludih zatvorenika bolnice dok je uloga medicinske sestre koja se bori protiv luđaka dospjela Vanessi Grasse.

programme.title: Savršeno oružje, film
programme.desc: U ne tako dalekoj budućnosti, društvo je pod nadzorom moćne države i diktatora zvanog Direktor. Condor za tu državu radi kao plaćeni ubojica, no ponovni susret s nekim za koga je mislio da je mrtav prisili ga da dobro promisli tko su mu zapravo neprijatelji. Jer svi su mete.

programme.title: Plan za vjenčanje, film
programme.desc: U 32. godini Michal se napokon raduje udobnosti i sigurnosti braka. Mjesec dana prije vjenčanja, dok su birali meni za svadbu, mladoženja se predomislio i vjenčanje je otkazano. Ne želeći se vratiti usamljenom slobodnom životu, Michal odluči vjerovati sudbini i nastaviti sa svojim planovima za vjenčanje, vjerujući da će se gospodin Pravi pojaviti do odabranog datuma.

programme.title: Alex Cross, film
programme.desc: Nova ekranizacija romana najplaćenijeg pisca na svijetu, Jamesa Pattersona, o policijskom psihologu Alexu Crossu. Film donosi priču o policijskom psihologu Alexu Cross-u koji istražuje jeziva ubojstva serijskog ubojice Michaela Sullivana aka The Butchera. Međutim sukob postaje osoban i Alex Cross a je gurnut na rub vlastitih moralnih i psiholoških granica...

programme.title: Jim Gumb i strojovođa Lukas, film
programme.desc: Jim Gumb, njegov kompić Lukas, vozač vlaka i Emma, lokomotiva, žive na malom otoku Morrowland. Jednoga dana krenu u veliku pustolovinu. Njihovo ih putovanje vodi do carstva cara Mandala, otkud se spremaju poći spasiti njegovu otetu kćer Li Si. Njih troje krenu u Grad zmaja da oslobode princezu i otkriju tajnu Jimova porijekla.

programme.title: Bježi, film
programme.desc: Nešto je zlokobno i neprirodno u odnosu majke Diane (Sarah Paulson) i kćeri Chloe (Kiera Allen). Prezaštitnički nastrojena Diane je od rođenja odgajala kćer u potpunoj izolaciji od svijeta. Kad Chloe odraste i postane mlada žena, počinje otkrivati da stvari u njihovoj kući nisu onakvima kakvima se čine. Postaje jasno da je veza Diane s kćeri neprirodna jer je cijelo vrijeme pokušava spriječiti da živi vlastitim životom - u biti je drži kao zarobljenicu u vlastitom domu. Chloe polako otkriva sve više tajni o svojoj „brižnoj majci, a opasna igra živaca tek počinje…

programme.title: Buđenje lovca na zmajeve, film
programme.desc: Kad Willu zmaj ubije oca, on kreće na putovanje osvete koje ga dovodi u tuđi dom u kojemu ostaje i gdje počinje raditi za tiranina Sterlinga kako bi naučio ubiti tu zvijer. Dok trenira, sprijatelji se s Sterlingovom kćeri Kateom, a Sterling postane sumnjičav i umišlja da mu Will prijeti. Svojim ljudima naredi da ga ubiju, no Will im umakne. Sad Will mora izbjegavati Sterlingove ljude i osvetiti svoga oca.

programme.title: Kaamelott: Prvo poglavlje, film
programme.desc: Deset je godina prošlo otkad se Arthur odrekao prijestolja i nestao nakon što ga je predao bivšem prijatelju Lancelotu, koji je od tada nad kraljevstvom uspostavio strašnu vladavinu. Vitezovi okruglog stola su se raspustili i u nekoliko navrata pokušali jadne bljeskove otpora protiv Lancelota. Svi se pitaju što se s Arthurom zapravo dogodilo, od Lancelota (koji mu želi smrt) pa sve do potlačenih malih ljudi (koji žele da se vrati). No, želi li se Arthur doista vratiti se u Kaamelott kako bi još jednom pomogao tim budalama i povratio prijestolje koje mu pripada?

programme.title: Opsadno stanje, film
programme.desc: Redatelj filma Planet majmuna: Postanak donosi potpuno drugačiji SF triler u kojem nema kriminala, nema siromaštva, nema nezaposlenosti ili je sve to samo prividno? Priča započinje u predgrađu Chicaga, desetljeće nakon što su izvanzemaljci okupirali Zemlju, te prikazuje perspektivu ljudskih kolaboracionista na jednoj i disidenata na drugoj strani.

programme.title: Opsadno stanje, film
programme.desc: Redatelj filma Planet majmuna: Postanak donosi potpuno drugačiji SF triler u kojem nema kriminala, nema siromaštva, nema nezaposlenosti ili je sve to samo prividno? Priča započinje u predgrađu Chicaga, desetljeće nakon što su izvanzemaljci okupirali Zemlju, te prikazuje perspektivu ljudskih kolaboracionista na jednoj i disidenata na drugoj strani.

programme.title: Smrtni neprijatelj, film
programme.desc: Max Fist (Manganiello) tvrdi da je junak iz druge dimenzije koji je pao kroz prostor i vrijeme na Zemlju, gdje nema moći. Nitko ne vjeruje u njegove priče osim mjesnoga tinejdžera Hamstera. Skupa krenu na ulice kako bi ih očistili od mjesne zločinačke mreže koja prodaje drogu i njezina šefa znanoga kao Managera.

programme.title: Smrtni neprijatelj, film

programme.title: Pali anđeo, serija
programme.desc: U kazni u samici i uznemirena Sjenama, Luce razmišlja što se to dogodilo pri pokušaju bijega. Progone je sjećanja na ozlijeđivanje Cama i kreće potražiti njegov medicinski karton kako bi otkrila istinu. Daniel, shrvan teškom kaznom, odbija pomoći, ali, kad ona upadne u nevolju, pomogne joj. Luce dolazi do kartona, ali i fotografije koja šokira - to je kratki uvid u Danielovu nemoguću prošlost.

programme.title: Gosti za odstrijel, film
programme.desc: Obitelj Davidson otišla je proslaviti godišnjicu braka u vikendicu na osamljenome mjestu. I baš kad su sjeli za stol večerati, napadnu ih tajanstvene, maskirane ubojice. Mobiteli su im blokirani. Dok se pitaju jesu li ih napali luđaci, raste broj mrtvih i ranjenih, ali netko od obitelji spreman je i sposoban uzvratiti im...

programme.title: Napad nepoznatoga, film
programme.desc: Dok svijet oko njih gori, tim specijalaca koji prevozi zlobnoga šefa zločinačke organizacije nađe se zatočenim unutar okružnog pritvora. Nemaju nikakvu komunikaciju s vanjskim svijetom i zajednički moraju uložiti napore kako bi umakli napadima izvanzemaljskih sila željnih krvi.

programme.title: Nakon prvih 48 sati
programme.desc: Nakon napada na beskućnika, jedini svjedok detektiva u Mobileu istovremeno je i osumnjičenik. Na suđenju svjedoci i optuženici upiru prstom jedan u drugoga, a zbog iznenadne situacije mladi tužitelj ne može riješiti svoj slučaj.

programme.title: Nakon prvih 48 sati
programme.desc: Nakon napada na beskućnika, jedini svjedok detektiva u Mobileu istovremeno je i osumnjičenik. Na suđenju svjedoci i optuženici upiru prstom jedan u drugoga, a zbog iznenadne situacije mladi tužitelj ne može riješiti svoj slučaj.

programme.title: Skvoteri
programme.desc: Patricia svoj dom u Washingtonu naziva utočištem već više od 60 godina. No nakon tragičnog gubitka sina i zdravstvene hitnosti zbog koje je morala otići, kuću su preplavili štakori i bespravni useljenici.

programme.title: Nakon prvih 48 sati
programme.desc: Nakon što su tri osobe ustrijeljene u kući u Tulsu, detektivi se suočavaju s dva osumnjičenika i mrežom laži. Tužitelji imaju samo dokaze na osnovi indicija kako bi osigurali slučaj protiv proračunatog, hladnokrvnog ubojice.

programme.title: Moje neobično uhićenje
programme.desc: Pregled nekih od najčudnijih uhićenja diljem zemlje. Goli muškarac navodno krade vozila ATV; policija posjećuje muškarca za kojeg se sumnja da je hranio aligatore.

programme.title: Moje neobično uhićenje
programme.desc: Muškarac vodi policiju u divlju potjeru u ukradenom poštanskom kamionu. Vlasnik restorana uhićen je nakon što je sakrio drogu u kutiji za dostavu. Dostavljač pizze pomaže policiji uhititi lopova; i još mnogo toga.

programme.title: Moje neobično uhićenje
programme.desc: Pregled nekih od najčudnijih uhićenja diljem zemlje. Muškarac zapne u dimnjaku dok pljačka kuću; vlasnici trgovine kućnih ljubimaca uhvate lopova s ukradenim zmijama u hlačama; muškarac provaljuje u sobu za bijeg i ne može pobjeći; i još puno toga.

programme.title: Moje neobično uhićenje
programme.desc: Pregled nekih od najčudnijih uhićenja diljem zemlje. Muškarac zapne u dimnjaku dok pljačka kuću; vlasnici trgovine kućnih ljubimaca uhvate lopova s ukradenim zmijama u hlačama; muškarac provaljuje u sobu za bijeg i ne može pobjeći; i još puno toga.

programme.title: Moje neobično uhićenje
programme.desc: Pogled na neka od najčudnijih uhićenja iz cijele zemlje: nevina žena inzistira na odlasku u zatvor sa svojom uhićenom BFF; lopov bježi s figurom u prirodnoj veličini; osumnjičeni u bijegu ostaje zarobljen u portalu; i više!

programme.title: Moje neobično uhićenje
programme.desc: Pregled nekih od najčudnijih uhićenja diljem zemlje. Muškarac prosi svoju djevojku dok ga privode; radnik u akvariju pomaže u hvatanju lopova morskog psa; konj i buggy postaju opasni kad pijani čovjek njima upravlja; i još mnogo toga.

programme.title: Moje neobično uhićenje
programme.desc: Pogled na neka od najčudnijih uhićenja iz cijele zemlje: očajna žena mora kakati tijekom prometne blokade; majka je uhićena dok se ušuljala u školu odjevena u svoju kćer; čovjek uskoči u akvarij od 24 000 galona u trgovini; i više!

programme.title: Moje neobično uhićenje
programme.desc: Pregled nekih od najčudnijih uhićenja diljem zemlje. Muškarac odlučuje pauzirati svoj zločin kako bi ispekao pizzu; policija prati muškarca koji je skočio kroz krov prijenosnog WC-a.

programme.title: Moje neobično uhićenje
programme.desc: Pogled na neka od najčudnijih uhićenja iz cijele zemlje: goli muškarac pravi scenu na Miami Beachu; pijani vozač pronalazi čudno i opasno mjesto da obavi nuždu; i više!

programme.title: Moje neobično uhićenje
programme.desc: Pogled na neka od najčudnijih uhićenja iz cijele zemlje: čovjek vodi aligatora u kupovinu namirnica; navodni lopov pokušava čudnom taktikom da prikrije svoj identitet; odbjegli osumnjičenik pronalazi neobično tijesno skrovište; i više!

programme.title: Moje neobično uhićenje
programme.desc: Pogled na neka od najčudnijih uhićenja iz cijele zemlje: zaustavljanje prometa dovodi do šokantnog uhićenja; vozačica bježi od nesreće s muškarcem koji se drži za haubu njezina auta, muškarac pokušava otrovati sendvič svog nećaka i još mnogo toga!

programme.title: Netko skriva nešto
programme.desc: Naoružani napadač ubija bivšeg člana bande, Aarona Iturru dok spava u svom krevetu. Konačno, detektivi iz Oregona povezuju tajanstveni telefonski poziv, lokalnog aktivista koji je protiv bandi i ukradenu kutiju cigareta.

programme.title: Nakon prvih 48 sati
programme.desc: Odjel za umorstva u Tulsi zalazi u mračni svijet droge i prostitucije kako bi riješio ubojstvo čovjeka pogubljenog u svom automobilu na parkiralištu motela.

programme.title: Lovci na bjegunce: Meksiko, Nevolje u raju
programme.desc: Lovci na bjegunce dobivaju trag o osuđenom seksualnom prijestupniku iz Nevade koji se skriva u odmaralištu na plaži 20 milja od granice SAD-a.

programme.title: Lovci na bjegunce: Meksiko, Tajna misija
programme.desc: Lovci na bjegunce idu pod krinku u teretanu kako bi uhvatili Amerikanca u bijegu, optuženog za ubojstvo u Kaliforniji. Potom se pretvaraju da su turisti u primorskom gradiću kako bi pronašli bjegunca iz San Diega traženog zbog trgovine drogom.

programme.title: Lovci na bjegunce: Meksiko, Život u zločinu
programme.desc: Lovci na bjegunce ulaze u jurnjavu velikom brzinom kako bi uhvatili osuđenog ubojicu iz Bakersfielda u Kaliforniji. Bjegunac iz Los Angelesa pokušava ostati korak ispred agenata u Tijuani.

programme.title: Posljednji put viđen na odmoru
programme.desc: U studenom 2024., 20-godišnji Tyler Kerry otputovao je s obitelji u Antaliju u Turskoj. Druge noći, Tyler je zaspao na kauču. Nekoliko trenutaka kasnije, nestao je. U ranim jutarnjim satima, njegovo je tijelo pronađeno na dnu okna dizala.

programme.title: Posljednji put viđen na odmoru
programme.desc: Godine 2004. Yvonne DeVries odvela je djecu, Maxa i Dominique, na Arubu. Kad joj je novi prijatelj ponudio da Maxa odvede na jet ski, Yvonne ga je pustila. Maxa više nisu vidjeli, ostavljajući Yvonne u potrazi za odgovorima desetljećima kasnije.

programme.title: Posljednji put viđen na odmoru
programme.desc: U listopadu 2017., Njujorčanka Desiree Gibbon otputovala je u Montego Bay na Jamajci. Navečer Dana zahvalnosti napustila je obiteljski pansion, rekavši da će se odmah vratiti. Tri dana kasnije, njezino je tijelo pronađeno na seoskoj cesti.

programme.title: Posljednji put viđen na odmoru
programme.desc: 61-godišnji Gary i Linda Haas putovali su kamperom u Colorado na svoje godišnje kampiranje. Nasilni počinitelji John McCluskey i Tracy Province ugledali su Garyja i Lindu na odmorištu te su im uz prijetnju oružjem oteli automobil.

programme.title: Posljednji put viđen na odmoru
programme.desc: Darryl je otputovao u Cabarete na ono što je trebalo biti kratko surfanje. Prije nestanka poslao je obitelji umirujuću poruku da će ih nazvati sljedećeg dana. To je bila posljednja poruka od njega.

programme.title: Moje neobično uhićenje
programme.desc: Pogled na neka od najbizarnijih uhićenja diljem zemlje: muškarac odjeven kao kokoš tvrdi da je pod utjecajem halucinogenih gljiva; žena pokušava iskoristiti policijski automobil kao taksi do bara, i još mnogo toga!

programme.title: Upoznao sam ubojicu na internetu
programme.desc: Svaka epizoda prepričava kako je internetska veza dovela do ubojstva. Bilo da je riječ o uzbuđenju zbog upoznavanja na mreži, primamljivosti shema za zaradu novca ili prilici za prevaru partnera, svaka priča je drugačija, ali svaka ima tragičan kraj.

programme.title: Vidi što si me natjerao da učinim, Smrtonosna ljubomora
programme.desc: Kada perspektivni biciklist biva hladnokrvno ustrijeljen, snimka s nadzorne kamere navodi istražitelje na uvjerenje da je žrtva možda bila ciljano napadnuta.

programme.title: Prijava za ubojstvo
programme.desc: U ranim jutarnjim satima 26. kolovoza 2015. hotelski djelatnik Khalilur Rahman ubijen je tijekom brutalnog napada u hotelu Woking na ulici Chertsey Road.

programme.title: Netko nešto skriva
programme.desc: Neobičan poziv hitnoj službi dovodi policiju na mjesto stravičnog ubojstva 43-godišnjeg Patricka McRaea. Pronađen je mrtav u svom domu, s teškim ubodnim ranama na vratu i ramenima.

programme.title: Ubojstva u 21. stoljeću, Ispod površine
programme.desc: Živahna 15-godišnja djevojka vješta u korištenju društvenih medija, nestaje u malom gradu, ostavljajući zajednicu zbunjenu. Dok je njezini najmiliji očajnički traže, lokalno mjesto za druženje tinejdžera možda krije tragove njezine konačne propasti.

programme.title: Svjedoci ubojstva: Digitalni dokaz
programme.desc: Kada 17-godišnja transrodna influencerica iz Vancouvera, Washington, iznenada utihne, njezina obitelj i obožavatelji strahuju od zločina. Digitalni podaci konačno omogućuju detektivima praćenje kretanja osumnjičenika na jutro počinjenog zločina.

programme.title: Scott Peterson: Novi dokazi
programme.desc: Više od 20 godina nakon tragične smrti Laci i Connera Petersona, višestruki zahtjevi koje je podnio obrambeni tim Scotta Petersona iznose nove dokaze koji bi mogli dovesti u pitanje ključne aspekte slučaja.

programme.title: Hladni slučajevi: Ubojstvo u Bayouu, Vrag u Hammondu
programme.desc: Kad je mlada majka Selonia Reed pronađena brutalno ubijena u svom autu, detektivi prevrću svaki kamen u gradiću Hammondu u Louisiani u potrazi za njezinim ubojicom. Seloniain slučaj čami više od 30 godina prije nego što je pravda konačno zadovoljena.

programme.title: Neriješeni slučajevi: Mrtvi zapad, Smrt nepoznate žene
programme.desc: Emisija "Neriješeni slučajevi" prati detektive i članove obitelji koji žude za time da se zadovolji pravda za žrtve i zbog čije predanosti slučajevi njihovih voljenih više nisu zaboravljeni u ladicama.

programme.title: Neriješeni slučajevi: Mrtvi zapad, Smrt nepoznate žene
programme.desc: Emisija "Neriješeni slučajevi" prati detektive i članove obitelji koji žude za time da se zadovolji pravda za žrtve i zbog čije predanosti slučajevi njihovih voljenih više nisu zaboravljeni u ladicama.

programme.title: Ubojite istrage
programme.desc: Lovci otkrivaju tijelo žene u šumi Georgije. Dok detektivi pokreću istragu ubojstva, pozornost se okreće njezinom bivšem suprugu, bivšem odvjetniku mornarice, čiji iskaz postavlja više pitanja nego odgovora.

programme.title: Moje neobično uhićenje
programme.desc: Pogled na neka od najčudnijih uhićenja iz cijele zemlje: nevina žena inzistira na odlasku u zatvor sa svojom uhićenom BFF; lopov bježi s figurom u prirodnoj veličini; osumnjičeni u bijegu ostaje zarobljen u portalu; i više!

programme.title: #Mrtav za mene
programme.desc: Simon Gilchrist bio je vrijedan mladić iz divne obitelji čiji je život okrutno prekinula njegova djevojka došavši kući nakon teškog pijanstva.

programme.title: Lovac na ubojstva, serija

programme.title: U sustavu: Prvi dan unutra
programme.desc: Brzi vozači i diplomat završe u zatvoru dok se ljubomorni dečko bori za ulazak. Gladni beskućnik donosi nepromišljenu odluku, a trudna mama se nada da neće roditi dok je u lisicama.

programme.title: Upoznao sam ubojicu na internetu
programme.desc: Svaka epizoda prepričava kako je internetska veza dovela do ubojstva. Bilo da je riječ o uzbuđenju zbog upoznavanja na mreži, primamljivosti shema za zaradu novca ili prilici za prevaru partnera, svaka priča je drugačija, ali svaka ima tragičan kraj.

programme.title: Neriješeni slučajevi, Dok nas smrt ne rastavi
programme.desc: Nakon samo dvije godine braka, Chuck otkriva da mu je žena Cheryl ubijena. Iako je Cherylina obitelj sigurna da poznaje njezina ubojicu, zakon nije tako siguran. Nakon nekoliko desetljeća DNK podudaranje briše svaku sumnju.

programme.title: Neriješeni slučajevi, Noćna mora u Sooner Stateu
programme.desc: Potkraj 1983. godine unakaženo tijelo Timothyja Cogginsa pronađeno je pored tzv. stabla za vješanje. Istraga je u slijepoj ulici više od 30 godina, sve dok se novi šerif ne obveže da će ubojice privesti pravdi.

programme.title: Neriješeni slučajevi, Nestali i ubijeni
programme.desc: U lipnju 1985. 20-godišnja kraljica festivala "Naivčina" pronađena je pretučena. Mala zajednica Nixa, Missouri, sigurna je da je njezina krv na rukama lokalnog bogatog poslovnog čovjeka, ali nakon 25 godina DNK otkriva pravog ubojicu.

programme.title: Suncem obasjana ubojstva
programme.desc: Dva se stranca susreću dok putuju s ruksakom kroz Tajland i frcaju iskre. Ali ova novopečena romansa u raju završava užasnom tragedijom.

programme.title: Ubojstva tijekom proljetnih praznika, Brittanee Drexel

programme.title: Ubojstva tijekom proljetnih praznika, Lynsie Ekelund

programme.title: Ubojstvo od strane liječnika, Anne Grigg Booth

programme.title: Ubojstvo od strane liječnika, Beverley Allitt
programme.desc: Od veljače do travnja 1991., teror Beverley Allitt u bolnici Grantham dovela je do smrti četvero djece i ozbiljne ozljede drugih. Njezina prošlost otkrila je zabrinjavajuće znakove Munchausenova sindroma koji su se manifestirali u ranoj dobi.

programme.title: Izum

Otkrijte neke od najuzbudljivijih proizvoda koje su stvorili europski znanstvenici i poduzetnici. Ova serija pokriva sve, od novog načina uštede energije do srčanih zalisaka uzgojenih u laboratoriju, od podvodnih jedara do robotskih vatrogasaca na daljinsko upravljanje.

programme.title: Futuris
programme.desc: Mogu li se na našim licima otkriti znakovi nadolazeće kardiovaskularne krize i mogu li se ti znakovi protumačiti na jednostavan način? Mogu li naša lica pokazivati znakove nadolazeće kardiovaskularne krizei mogu li se ti znakovi protumačiti na pouzdan način? Talijanski znanstvenici daju korisne odgovore sa svojim "čarobnim zrcalom" koje prepoznaje čimbenike rizika na licu.

programme.title: Futuris
programme.desc: Znanstvenici su razvili robote koji govore kako bi pomagali starijim osobama u svakodnevnim aktivnostima i poboljšanju života. Portugalski znanstvenici razvili su robote koji govore, čuju i izražavaju emocije izrazima lica. Osmišljeni su kao pomoć starijim osobama u obavljanju svakodnevnih aktivnosti i poboljšanju svakodnevnog života. Ali, radi li to? Mogu li roboti doista zamijeniti ljude?

programme.title: Ta jedna stvar

Serijski Guinnessov rekorder i majstor borilačkih vještina Vispy Kharadi otkriva što je potrebno da postanete najbolji te pokazuje borilačke vještine i tehnike samoobrane.

programme.title: Gimnastičarske zvijezde

programme.title: Futuris

Na Sveučilištu Lichtenstein istraživači eksperimentiraju s novim načinom proizvodnje energije. Zato su ispunili prozore spremnika tekućinom koja cirkulira. Idealno, svaki prozor će proizvoditi do 1 kilovat energije na sat (1 kWh).

programme.title: Everyday Elements
programme.desc: A series that puts chemistry in our everyday experience by showing the living connection we have with the chemicals and elements that make up our world. The matter that built skies and seas, the atoms that make up you and me, the chemistry around us that forms the things we touch, smell and see. This series shows us what the objects in our universe and in our homes are made from and why the particles around us behave as they do. Everything around us is built from Everyday Elements.

programme.title: Of Boats And Men
programme.desc: Travelling by boat bears a priceless sense of Freedom and offers endless new vistas to all passengers. Across waterways around the world Boats are an essential tool of daily life whether they carry goods, serve as utilities or services in remote areas.

programme.title: Dream Journey
programme.desc: February 2017 saw me embark upon a travel expedition through Scotland, Poland, France, Mexico, Belize and, (alas!), back. Not only was it the first time I ventured out to Central America, but also the first time I seriously pushed my bravery boundaries to do a whole lot of things I'd never tried before. I defeated my life-long fear of scubadiving and skydiving, (the Carribbean vistas do help! _ No danger I'd do that again in Aberdeen), I went zip-lining over a Mexican jungle, I tried habanero-packed streetfood, (failed at that miserably), and organic tequila, (managed that better;), I climbed a Maya pyramid in the middle of a Belizean rainforest and fed hibiscus flowers to a very extravagant donkey. Most importantly, however, I got to know some incredible people _ from shamans, wanderers and artists to refugees, businesswomen and expat cowboys. And thanks to aaaall of that, I also got to know a little bit more about myself for visiting the most remote corners of our planet reminds you how different and yet how similar we all are. I'm looking forward to sharing my incredible experience in 5 exciting episodes of our travel series, which really turned out to be a Dream Journey:) I sim

programme.title: Show Me Where You Live
programme.desc: Show me where you live is a documentary series that aims to answer the following question: How can human beings claim ownership to a space so that they can live safely within it, function as a society, and above all be in harmony with the environment around them? As we discover cultures and emblematic populations, we follow Philippe Simay who is at the heart of Inhabiting the World and represents its identity and originality. Philippe takes us on an epic adventure around the Human Habitat and sets the tone for the journey. As a humanist and philosopher, Philippe is a tireless surveyor of the city, and an explorer of living spaces. Determined to travel around the world, Philippe unveils how the populations that he encounters claim the space they occupy, shapes it and adjust to it.

programme.title: Nomads
programme.desc: This unconventional road trip follows the "Local Exposure Tour," in search of the next BMX pro rider. It follows some of the biggest names in BMX as they search for a BMX "grom" deserving of the opportunity of a lifetime.

programme.title: Music Voyager
programme.desc: Music Voyager is a music and travel broadcast series (television/cable, broadband, in-flight and mobile) that invites viewers to discover the exciting sounds of the planet. The host is Jacob Edgar, an explorer who does not search for lost cities or ancient ruins. He's on the quest for a different kind of treasure…music. As an ethnomusicologist and world music record producer, Edgar travels the globe hunting for the best songs the world has to offer, and he suffers through some of the worst…so you don't have to. Along the way, he's rewarded with a backstage pass to concert halls, street festivals, recording studios and rehearsal rooms. With local musicians as his guide, Edgar tastes exotic and occasionally ghastly food, visits off-the-beaten path attractions and parties the night away to amazing concerts at hidden venues that only the locals know. Join music voyager for unexpected adventures and surprising discoveries that unveil the magic, mystery and music of far off lands.

programme.title: Rip Files
programme.desc: Major Graham's Mansion, in the Virginia countryside, houses dark secrets that the team attempts to uncover.

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: In this episode, Ray explores the Red Centre of the country and shows that the Australian desert is filled with life for those who know where to find water.He arrives in the Red Centre by chopper as he flies over the Uluru monolith or Ayres Rock. For his first stop, he goes to a red kangaroo sanctuary where he cuddles a joey, meets their carer Brolga and gets close to the usually wary adult red kangaroos. He pursues his journey deeper in the desert to meet a local aboriginal Sammy Wilson. They go to a traditional waterhole and chat over a camp fire about Sammy's ancestral knowledge of the land. Ray spends the night out under the stars before driving more inland to rocky areas where water collects. There Ray comes face to face with a wild kangaroo and rock wallabies. He then follows tracks along a dry river bed that lead him to Australia's wild dog: a dingo.

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: As Loro Parque's head vet, Jorge never knows from one day to the next what will come through his clinic. From tending to oversexed otters, fine-footed flamingoes or armoured armadillos, a day spent with Jorge, is a day immersed in nature from the four corners of the globe. Ever seen a grown man hug a turtle? For Javier, Loro Parque's Head of Environmental Affairs, it's all part of the job! He's hitting the high seas of Tenerife with a turtle tracker in hand to help with scientific research _ but first he's just got to locate the turtle _ 2,000 meters down in the ocean!

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: "Finding Nemo" may have brought fame to the striped clownfish but their newfound popularity has sent worldwide numbers into decline. Now we follow the aquarium team as they initiate their very own breeding program with the hope of finding many more Nemos to come. Jorge has got a 200-pound problem on his hands. Lin Mao the white tiger has something wrong with his hip and the vets need to make a diagnosis. Problem is, Lin Mao's not responding to the anesthetic Jorge just administered and he has to decide what to do next...very quickly.

programme.title: Meet My Wild Friend
programme.desc: Gasp at animal power, gawp at childhood innocence, this is the true story of children who live as friends with wild animals.

programme.title: European Islands
programme.desc: The European islands are renowned primarily for their hotel resorts. However, we will show you a completely different face of theirs: forests, beaches, coves, mountains, valleys and rivers. Perhaps you will find places that will take your breath away. Why just lie on the beach when there is so much to see? Put on some good hiking shoes, pull your shoelaces tight, and get to know the entire island like the back of your hand.

programme.title: Outta Town Adventures
programme.desc: Outta Town Adventures travels both near and far to discover the best advenures the destinations have to offer. This TV series is dedicated to presenting history, culture and geography in a fun and pisitive way. It encourages people to explore this beautiful world _ something that starts with simply getting out of town.

programme.title: Wild Ones
programme.desc: Archer Fish _ A precise hunter, it shoots water jets to knock prey from above. Portia Spider _ Tiny but smart, this spider hunts others with strategy and speed. Cone Shell _ A slow-moving snail with a deadly harpoon for catching fish. Bolas Spider _ Spins sticky globules to snare prey in the dark. Slave-Making Ants _ Some ants enslave others to build their colonies. Ant Lion _ A fierce larva that traps ants in sandy pits. Pompilid Wasp _ Hunts spiders with deadly precision. Who rules the micro predator world?

programme.title: Wild Ones
programme.desc: We live in a world full of the most magnificent of animals. There are approximately eight point seven (8.7) million different species on earth. With this vast array of natural wonders how do we choose a favorite amongst all these spectacular creatures? The ethereal grace of the oceans whales, the might of the imposing hippo, the unequalled speed of the cheetah, the mesmerizing lure of the snake, the power of the elephant, the strength of the ant, the stealth of the scorpion, the extraordinary talents of the octopus, the force of the crocodile, the sheer grace of the wedge tailed eagle, or the regular commanding presence of the lion...

programme.title: Blue Realm
programme.desc: Miracle Venom explores the strange, and often bizarre world of the oceans most venomous animals. Follow Dr. Glen Burns as he handles deadly Sea Snakes with only his bare hands. You'll be amazed at how a small Cone Snail hunts, paralyses and then eats it's prey alive. The waters of Papua New Guinea and Australia's Great Barrier Reef harbour an exceptional variety of venomous fish and invertebrates.The poisons of these animals are some of the most lethal known to man.They also, however, hold enormous potential in the development of therapeutic drugs.

programme.title: Sarah Shark
programme.desc: Sarah travels to one of the top 10 dive destinations in Australia (Julian Rocks, Byron Bay, NSW) to dive with three species of Wobbegong Sharks within the Cape Byron Marine Park. She also conducts a street poll with members of the public to find out what they think about sharks.

programme.title: Race of Life
programme.desc: In nature, both males and females fight fiercely—especially females defending their young. Most battles occur within the same species over food, territory, status, or mates. While not always fatal, these fights can lead to death. Animals protect food sources directly or by defending territory rich in prey. This territorial aggression helps distribute populations but can also limit them—like wolves starving without territory. Though fighting can secure survival, it comes at a cost: injury, exhaustion, and death. Often, avoiding conflict is the wisest strategy.

programme.title: Race of Life
programme.desc: Prey must constantly avoid predators, and any defensive adaptation boosts survival. Speed is a key defense—antelope are built to run, chased by sprinters like cheetahs. Over time, predators evolved to be fast, and prey evolved to be faster. Antelope also travel long distances for food. Ostriches, though flightless, are the fastest-running birds. The Golden Wheel spider escapes danger by turning into a rolling wheel. In the Race of Life, survival depends on clever, sometimes surprising adaptations.

programme.title: On the Cities' Rooftops
programme.desc: How is life on the city's roofs? This series scales new heights, exploring apartment buildings, towers and monuments to discover a world full of unsuspected treasures : our rooftops. By day and night, the population changes on these heights. There are people who work here, people who live here, and others who come here to relax. The world's rooftops are a continual hive of activity.

programme.title: Dream Journey
programme.desc: February 2017 saw me embark upon a travel expedition through Scotland, Poland, France, Mexico, Belize and, (alas!), back. Not only was it the first time I ventured out to Central America, but also the first time I seriously pushed my bravery boundaries to do a whole lot of things I'd never tried before. I defeated my life-long fear of scubadiving and skydiving, (the Carribbean vistas do help! _ No danger I'd do that again in Aberdeen), I went zip-lining over a Mexican jungle, I tried habanero-packed streetfood, (failed at that miserably), and organic tequila, (managed that better;), I climbed a Maya pyramid in the middle of a Belizean rainforest and fed hibiscus flowers to a very extravagant donkey. Most importantly, however, I got to know some incredible people _ from shamans, wanderers and artists to refugees, businesswomen and expat cowboys. And thanks to aaaall of that, I also got to know a little bit more about myself for visiting the most remote corners of our planet reminds you how different and yet how similar we all are. I'm looking forward to sharing my incredible experience in 5 exciting episodes of our travel series, which really turned out to be a Dream Journey:) I sim

programme.title: Blue World
programme.desc: In this epic octopus adventure, Jonathan visits two aquaria to learn about the Giant Pacific octopus, and then travels to Seattle, Washington (USA) to join the Seattle Aquarium dive team on an octopus survey. He meets the Giant Pacific Octopus, the world's largest octopus, and discovers how clever this huge invertebrate really is!

programme.title: Blue World
programme.desc: Jonathan joins shark researcher Dr. Stephen Kajiura to test how well wild sharks can detect electrical fields in their environment. Then, he heads to New Jersey (USA) to learn how to dive in the Mark V commercial diving helmet! Finally, he ends up in the Gulf of Mexico to learn how oil platforms can actually become a healthy artificial reef and attract marine life from miles around.

programme.title: Quirky Science
programme.desc: Edison didn't invent the light bulb—he made it practical. Early lighting included unsafe limelight and blinding arc lamps. Edison tested thousands of filaments, even a beard hair, to improve bulb life. Others explored gas-based bulbs, leading to energy-saving lamps. Lasers, once Einstein's theory, became essential tech. Today, lighting innovations include invisible wavelengths and even laser therapy. What's next in the evolution of light?

programme.title: Quirky Science
programme.desc: Alexander Graham Bell, inspired by a misunderstood German paper, aimed to send multiple tones through a wire—leading to the invention of the telephone. He discovered that voice vibrations vary electric current strength, enabling sound transmission. Though revolutionary, it took time for people to grasp its impact. Today, wireless calls dominate, yet still rely on Bell's principles. As tech evolves, we may soon see phoneless communication.

programme.title: Wow, I Never Knew That!
programme.desc: It's the city of love, Paris, France. The world over knows its most famous structure, the Eiffel Tower! But did you know parisians originally wanted to tear it down! We'll explain why and how it was saved! Then, you'll visit America's first pizzeria! And how the gourmet ice cream Haagen Dazs got its exotic start in Bronx New York!

programme.title: Wow, I Never Knew That!
programme.desc: It's been sweetening America for almost 40 years! Now, find out the truth behind how Sweet N Low actually got its name! And why do we yell shotgun when getting into a car with friends? Then, is it really bad luck to open an umbrella in the house? And, learn the salty truth on how the potato chip was invented out of anger!

programme.title: New Frontier
programme.desc: The commercial space flight companies are edging closer and closer to flight readiness. Paying customers will soon be launching into space; tourists and their money is thought to be a major step forward into space and beyond. Blue Origin flight tests have been a great success and may launch commercial flights as soon as year's end. Virgin Galactic is also smashing mile stones towards flight certification. SpaceX and its Manned Dragon capsule in direct competition with Boeings moves closer to an ISS taxi service.

programme.title: New Frontier
programme.desc: The ESA _ JAXA joint Bepi-Colombo Mission is moments away from launch. The target is Mercury which has been too long neglected; this mission will shed new light on this strange world of light and dark.

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.desc: It's the biggest museum in the world…the museum of artworks stolen over the centuries and never rediscovered. These works haunt the nightmares of their owners, and occupy the days of hundreds of police officers across the world, as well as those of a handful of private agencies; no country or museum of importance can claim to have been spared. According to Interpol, art theft is the fourth largest criminal trade, after the drug trade, the weapons trade and money laundering. How could it be otherwise, when the soaring price of art propels the value of some paintings into the tens of millions of Euros? This world appears to be full of mysteries. Crime syndicates rub shoulders with petty criminals and the police care more about recovering the items than they do about arresting the perpetrators.

programme.title: Wonder
programme.desc: Iridescence causes surfaces to reflect shifting colors due to light interference. Chemiluminescence produces light via chemical reactions, while bioluminescence does the same in living organisms using luciferin and luciferase. Gemstone colors come from structural elements or impurities affecting light absorption. Mechanical plant defenses include thorns, spines, and microscopic features that help plants survive threats.

programme.title: Wonder
programme.desc: Vear is when visuals trigger imagined sounds, like the silent thud in the jumping pylon illusion. Retinal fatigue causes afterimages after staring at one color too long. The Müller-Lyer illusion tricks us into seeing equal lines as different lengths due to arrowheads. The Ames Room distorts size perception through skewed architecture. Synesthesia links senses—some people see colors when hearing sounds due to hyperconnected neurons.

programme.title: Dream Journey

programme.title: Show Me Where You Live
programme.desc: Show me where you live is a documentary series that aims to answer the following question: How can human beings claim ownership to a space so that they can live safely within it, function as a society, and above all be in harmony with the environment around them? As we discover cultures and emblematic populations, we follow Philippe Simay who is at the heart of Inhabiting the World and represents its identity and originality. Philippe takes us on an epic adventure around the Human Habitat and sets the tone for the journey. As a humanist and philosopher, Philippe is a tireless surveyor of the city, and an explorer of living spaces. Determined to travel around the world, Philippe unveils how the populations that he encounters claim the space they occupy, shapes it and adjust to it.

programme.title: Music Voyager
programme.desc: Music Voyager is a music and travel broadcast series (television/cable, broadband, in-flight and mobile) that invites viewers to discover the exciting sounds of the planet. The host is Jacob Edgar, an explorer who does not search for lost cities or ancient ruins. He's on the quest for a different kind of treasure…music. As an ethnomusicologist and world music record producer, Edgar travels the globe hunting for the best songs the world has to offer, and he suffers through some of the worst…so you don't have to. Along the way, he's rewarded with a backstage pass to concert halls, street festivals, recording studios and rehearsal rooms. With local musicians as his guide, Edgar tastes exotic and occasionally ghastly food, visits off-the-beaten path attractions and parties the night away to amazing concerts at hidden venues that only the locals know. Join music voyager for unexpected adventures and surprising discoveries that unveil the magic, mystery and music of far off lands.

programme.title: Rip Files
programme.desc: Long-hidden secrets are revealed through the R.I.P. team's talents and unique experiences, including those thought to be lost forever.

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: Westward ho! We settle in Salt Lake City, where we learn about Bringham Young's settlement of the Utah territory and his monument at This is the Place Park. Then we dig in the dirt to find hundreds of perfectly preserved dinosaurs at the Utah Natural History museum. We'll take a look at some US aviation history at the Hill Air force Base museum, and see how life was like for the Utah pioneers at Frontier Homestead State Park.

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: TTH heads to the great white North…kind of. We visit the world class city of Toronto. There we'll head straight up the Western Hemisphere's tallest structure, the CN Tower. Next we score a look at the Hockey Hall of Fame and see a North American castle at Casa Loma. Finally we see how the British defended their city against the newly formed United States at Fort York.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: Journey inside Dust Storms to see how they are formed and the hazards and effects they cause. A glimpse into the science of Clouds and how they fit into the weather cycle of the planet. The power of Lightening is more than visual, it is noise, electricity and it even helps plants to grow. Did you know that Rain droplets have different shapes and temperatures, it's maybe more interesting than you think?

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: Heatwaves have caused cities to literally meltdown and systems to fail, how are we working with nature's heat? When two Cyclones collide, we get the Fujiwhara Effect, how is this possible and how does it manifest? Floods occur around the world and the world is learning how to cope, combat and prevent damage and share lessons. How do you classify a Blizzard, and let's look at some of the worst blizzards that have occurred on earth. Do you really know how to measure Rainfall and how to identify violent rain from a shower or appreciate when we have had enough or too much?

programme.title: Big Coast
programme.desc: In the spirit of coastal conservation, Big Coast practices catch-and-release Tyee Chinook Salmon (over 30lbs) angling and only taking what you need. Going strong for 15 years, Big Coast features 13 new half hour episodes every year! A 300-mile boat trip from Vancouver to Duncanby Lodge in Rivers Inlet for Percy Walkus Hatchery Chinook Fundraiser!

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: Ray takes the Great Ocean Road along the Antarctic facing coast of Australia _ the longest South facing coastline in the world. He starts in Port Philp Bay the entrance to Melbourne Harbour where for the first time he sees a strange marine creature _ the weedy sea dragon _ a relative of the sea horse. He also swims with a unique species of dolphin _ the Burrunan Dolphins.Crossing the Bay he heads off down the longest War Memorial in the world _ the Great Ocean Road and meets 93 year old Doug Stirling who remembers the world war 1 veterans building the road.Ray visits the Penguin Colony on Middle Island where guard dogs protect the penguins from foxes and he watches the night time return of the penguins after a day spent at sea fishing.He takes to the seas and discovers the creatures of the deep waters _ albatross, balls of krill and a pod of fast moving common dolphins.

programme.title: Sarah Shark
programme.desc: Sarah travels to one of the top 10 dive destinations in Australia (Julian Rocks, Byron Bay, NSW) to dive with three species of Wobbegong Sharks within the Cape Byron Marine Park. She also conducts a street poll with members of the public to find out what they think about sharks.

programme.title: Outta Town Adventures
programme.desc: Outta Town Adventures travels both near and far to discover the best advenures the destinations have to offer. Season 1 visits attractions from California to Rwanda, Switzerland, Iceland, Utah, Zambia, Mexico, The Grand Canyon, Georgia (the Eastern European one) Louisiana, Hawaii, Mauritius and Seychelles. This TV series is dedicated to presenting history, culture and geography in a fun and pisitive way. It encourages people to explore this beautiful world _ something that starts with simply getting out of town!

programme.desc: This episode tackles a universal threat: epidemics and pandemics. Unlike earthquakes or floods, disease can strike anywhere and spread globally in a flash. Recent fears of pandemics feel more real than ever. We examine Ebola and Cholera in Africa, SARS and Bird Flu in Asia, and the resurgence of Cholera despite past victories. Smallpox may be gone, but vigilance is key—epidemics ignore borders. Survival depends on individual care and collective action against outbreaks.

programme.title: RV Explorers
programme.desc: RV Explorers, chasing 100 Sunsets. A TV show following a new motorhoming couple as they explore the towns and regions of NZ _ experiencing various tourist attractions, events and joining in with other motorhomers to experience their favourite activities.

programme.title: The Past Hunters
programme.desc: Derek Acorah's The Past Hunters travel to Hull to investigate ghostly goings on inside of a former chocolate factory. The investigation turns out to be no picnic, as the ghosts haunting make direct contact with the team.

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: Go for launch! We visit Space Shuttle Endeavor at the California Science Center. Then, we check out the glitch and glamour at the Hollywood Museum. We'll learn about the Holocaust at the Holocaust Museum and Japanese Internment during WWII at the Japanese/American National Museum. After that, we dig for bones at the famous La Brea Tar Pits.

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: Up, up and away! We discover St. Petersburg Florida's aviation roots at the St.Pete History Museum. Then, comb your mustache, we visit the Dali Museum to look at Salvador Dali's amazing masterworks. We'll dredge the deep looking for sponges, and defend the bay at Fort Desoto.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: A snapshot of Seasons, how they work together and keep the globe in balance. Droughts are explored in terms of how we can predict them, proof our lives from them and collect data because of them. Hurricanes are explained, their power revealed and the measures that are used to help us survive their impact. Thunderstorms have a few stages of development that roll out in a particular order.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: How are Rainbows formed and what's their science? We look at the largest Hail ever recorded and explain why it comes in so many shapes and sizes. Global Warming is a big issue and topic, and we give a nutshell insight to its meaning and impact on many levels. Forecasting is key and crucial to living with nature and its weather, as it involves precision technologies and expertise. Typhoon Halyan is an example of one of the most devastating storms in recent history and its story illustrates the power and destruction that Typhoons can cause.

programme.title: Big Coast
programme.desc: Fishing Prince Rupert, Ha-Nee-Nah Lodge on Dundas Island and Hecate Strait for Chinook Salmon and Pacific Halibut!

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: In this episode, Ray explores the Red Centre of the country and shows that the Australian desert is filled with life for those who know where to find water.He arrives in the Red Centre by chopper as he flies over the Uluru monolith or Ayres Rock. For his first stop, he goes to a red kangaroo sanctuary where he cuddles a joey, meets their carer Brolga and gets close to the usually wary adult red kangaroos. He pursues his journey deeper in the desert to meet a local aboriginal Sammy Wilson. They go to a traditional waterhole and chat over a camp fire about Sammy's ancestral knowledge of the land. Ray spends the night out under the stars before driving more inland to rocky areas where water collects. There Ray comes face to face with a wild kangaroo and rock wallabies. He then follows tracks along a dry river bed that lead him to Australia's wild dog: a dingo.

programme.title: Sarah Shark
programme.desc: Sarah travels to one of the top 10 dive destinations in Australia (Julian Rocks, Byron Bay, NSW) to dive with three species of Wobbegong Sharks within the Cape Byron Marine Park. She also conducts a street poll with members of the public to find out what they think about sharks.

programme.title: Outta Town Adventures
programme.desc: Outta Town Adventures travels both near and far to discover the best advenures the destinations have to offer. Season 1 visits attractions from California to Rwanda, Switzerland, Iceland, Utah, Zambia, Mexico, The Grand Canyon, Georgia (the Eastern European one) Louisiana, Hawaii, Mauritius and Seychelles. This TV series is dedicated to presenting history, culture and geography in a fun and pisitive way. It encourages people to explore this beautiful world _ something that starts with simply getting out of town!

programme.title: Music Voyager
programme.desc: Music Voyager is a music and travel broadcast series (television/cable, broadband, in-flight and mobile) that invites viewers to discover the exciting sounds of the planet. The host is Jacob Edgar, an explorer who does not search for lost cities or ancient ruins. He's on the quest for a different kind of treasure…music. As an ethnomusicologist and world music record producer, Edgar travels the globe hunting for the best songs the world has to offer, and he suffers through some of the worst…so you don't have to. Along the way, he's rewarded with a backstage pass to concert halls, street festivals, recording studios and rehearsal rooms. With local musicians as his guide, Edgar tastes exotic and occasionally ghastly food, visits off-the-beaten path attractions and parties the night away to amazing concerts at hidden venues that only the locals know. Join music voyager for unexpected adventures and surprising discoveries that unveil the magic, mystery and music of far off lands.

programme.title: Show Me Where You Live
programme.desc: Show me where you live is a documentary series that aims to answer the following question: How can human beings claim ownership to a space so that they can live safely within it, function as a society, and above all be in harmony with the environment around them? As we discover cultures and emblematic populations, we follow Philippe Simay who is at the heart of Inhabiting the World and represents its identity and originality. Philippe takes us on an epic adventure around the Human Habitat and sets the tone for the journey. As a humanist and philosopher, Philippe is a tireless surveyor of the city, and an explorer of living spaces. Determined to travel around the world, Philippe unveils how the populations that he encounters claim the space they occupy, shapes it and adjust to it.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: Bangalore is a city with many names: the Garden City, the Pub City, the Fashion Capital the list goes on. Follow Bill as he journeys through this city of contrasts and touches on its many faces. We visit Cubbon Park and Lal Bagh Gardens, shop in the markets and explore the nightlife of the modern city. We also explore architecture, from ancient Bull Temple, the legendary source of the Vishva Bharti River to the largest legislative building in India. Bill's final stop is the "Queen of the Hill Stations" Ooty, where he tours the plantations, rides the historic narrow-gauge railroad and visits the Stone House, which was built by the British in the days of colonial rule.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: These two national parks have some of the most diverse wildlife found on the Indian subcontinent. From the ancestors of our domesticated livestock to leopards, bear and elephants—this is a photographer's paradise. Join Bill as he attempts to track down two of the hardest predators to photograph—the leopard and the sloth bear.

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: All the essentials for going on, and having a successful safari are covered before our host gets a very special challenge—to find at least half of the "Big Twelve" on one safari drive. Four hours and six (6) very special animals—can he do it using his own rules for a successful safari?

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: We elect to stay on a few extra days to try and obtain some good leopard footage. These are the most elusive of the "Big Twelve" and filming them is a major challenge. In the process of tracking leopards, we run across a newborn gazelle trying to walk for the first time. Will it succeed before the predators find it? Can we find and film a leopard up close?

programme.title: Nomads
programme.desc: First people to free ski big mountain lines in Japan. Long travel times to Japan and ski opportunities were not the only obstacles on their way to explore Japan's backcountry.

programme.title: Nomads
programme.desc: This episode will follow "Team Cannondale" riders as they explore the European Alps, and all it has to offer for the mountain bike culture.

programme.title: Dream Journey
programme.desc: February 2017 saw me embark upon a travel expedition through Scotland, Poland, France, Mexico, Belize and, (alas!), back. Not only was it the first time I ventured out to Central America, but also the first time I seriously pushed my bravery boundaries to do a whole lot of things I'd never tried before. I defeated my life-long fear of scubadiving and skydiving, (the Carribbean vistas do help! _ No danger I'd do that again in Aberdeen), I went zip-lining over a Mexican jungle, I tried habanero-packed streetfood, (failed at that miserably), and organic tequila, (managed that better;), I climbed a Maya pyramid in the middle of a Belizean rainforest and fed hibiscus flowers to a very extravagant donkey. Most importantly, however, I got to know some incredible people _ from shamans, wanderers and artists to refugees, businesswomen and expat cowboys. And thanks to aaaall of that, I also got to know a little bit more about myself for visiting the most remote corners of our planet reminds you how different and yet how similar we all are. I'm looking forward to sharing my incredible experience in 5 exciting episodes of our travel series, which really turned out to be a Dream Journey:) I sim

programme.title: Of Boats And Men
programme.desc: Travelling by boat bears a priceless sense of Freedom and offers endless new vistas to all passengers. Across waterways around the world Boats are an essential tool of daily life whether they carry goods, serve as utilities or services in remote areas.

programme.title: Show Me Where You Live
programme.desc: Show me where you live is a documentary series that aims to answer the following question: How can human beings claim ownership to a space so that they can live safely within it, function as a society, and above all be in harmony with the environment around them? As we discover cultures and emblematic populations, we follow Philippe Simay who is at the heart of Inhabiting the World and represents its identity and originality. Philippe takes us on an epic adventure around the Human Habitat and sets the tone for the journey. As a humanist and philosopher, Philippe is a tireless surveyor of the city, and an explorer of living spaces. Determined to travel around the world, Philippe unveils how the populations that he encounters claim the space they occupy, shapes it and adjust to it.

programme.title: Mediterranean, In the Cetacean Footsteps
programme.desc: This documentary explores the paths of knowledge of Mediterranean Cetaceans. With scientists, veterinarians, representatives of associations, amateur or professional fishermen, we discover these mammals as well as major issues looming over their presence in this particular area of the globe. Through their very survival in the Mediterranean Sea we have a natural barometer of the "health level" of the local ecosystem. We focus on follow various peoples during their missions on a daily basis. All with a clear stated desire in mind, that being to look through the prism of this human mosaic working on the species survival... and thus contributing on sustainable development. This assembly has the potential to increase by tenfold the general public interest towards these sea creatures.

programme.title: European Identities
programme.desc: What is European Identity? Is it cultural or political? Thibault Bourdon travels 8500 Km on his bicycle crossing multitude of dialects & landscapes, majestic mountains, stunning cliffs across the continent exploring this political & economic cohesion of 750 million people. In the end, the project of the European Union is a beautiful idea but, for Europeans.

programme.title: Islands In A Desert Sea
programme.desc: Baja California _ a 1000 mile long desert peninsula. The Sea of Cortez, separating it from the Mexican mainland, is studded with islands, large and small.It's a sea teeming with lifeThe islands may be barren but oceanic upwellings draw in massive schools of fishAnd this richness attracts the inevitable predators. Biologically speaking, this is the richest body of water on our entire planet. The calm waters among the islands are perfect breeding grounds, creatures migrating thousands of miles to spawn their next generation here. Primeval forces draw giants here on an annual migration from frozen northern seas. Other creatures also travel thousands of miles to nest here on tiny dots in the ocean. The sea of Cortez has been relentlessly exploited by man, driving some species to the brink of extinction. Yet this almost land-locked sea also provides evidence of the remarkable resilience of the ocean. And it also shows us how we humans can sometimes make a difference...

programme.title: Under the Lights: Pele
programme.desc: A biography of the greatest player of all time on the pitch and one of the most iconic legends in sport.

programme.title: Man Eaters
programme.desc: The first documentary about the Human-leopard conflict in Sri Lanka, "Man Eaters: A Human Leopard Story" approaches the conflict by analyzing past and present cases of man-eating leopards in Sri Lanka and what led to their strange behavior. Unlike India, man-eating leopards in Sri Lanka are very rare.

programme.title: Yemen - Kids and the War
programme.desc: It is an exceptional documentary, filmed in a country no camera can penetrate _ a world exclusive. In a context in which the biggest international networks are unable to present images of this forgotten war, the Yemeni director Khadija Al Salami has entrusted her camera to 3 children who become war correspondents for this documentary in Yemen. Ahmed is 11, Rima is 8 and Youssef is 9. It is them who will recount the daily life of theYemeni people under Saudi airstrikes. They meet other kids, collecting the testimonies of wounded children in hospital and those who lost their parents in the airstrikes. With the innocence of children, they also interview adults _ a painter, a rapper, a model who has become "Miss War" on social media _ and ask them to send a message to those who they believe are the only ones who can stop the war _ the EuropeanUnion. Constructed like a story tale, with no images of violence, this deeply moving documentary shows the cruel reality of war through the eyes of children, and the incredible hope that they place in Europe to put an end to the conflict.

programme.title: Kordiljeri snova
programme.desc: Kordiljeri snova posljednji je dio dokumentarne trilogije posvećene istraživanju odnosa između prirodne baštine i kompleksne političke povijesti Čilea. Dok se u Nostalgiji za svjetlošću (2010.) bavi sjeverom, a u Bisernom dugmetu (2015.) jugom zemlje, treći dio posvećuje čileanskoj beskrajnoj kralježnici, impozantnom planinskom lancu koji se prostire cijelom dužinom zemlje. U razgovorima s čileanskim umjetnicima i znanstvenicima, Guzman propituje mjesto i simboliku Kordiljera u kolektivnoj svijesti nacije, koji za mnoge figuriraju kao majka koja istovremeno štiti i izolira zemlju od ostatka svijeta.

programme.title: Frajeri
programme.desc: "Frajeri" je prekrasno snimljen, vješto napravljen dokumentarac o životu u opakom pariškom predgrađu Aulnay-sous-Bois, prikazan kroz oči jedanaestero srednjoškolaca, od kojih su većina francuski državljani prve generacije. Govoreći izravno pred kamerom ovi izvanredni mladi ljudi govore o ljubavi, o tome kako je biti Francuz, životu na periferiji i njihovim vizijama budućnosti. „Frajeri zavodi ne samo zrelošću, velikodušnošću i iskrenošću ovih mladih ljudi, već naporima filmaša da ga podigne iz prosjeka uključivanjem šarmantnih letova fantazija koji ilustriraju dječje neizgovorene snove. „Frajeri je mnogo više od još jednog dokumentarnog filma o dječijoj otpornosti u izazovnim okolnostima.

programme.title: Odrastanje, dokumentarni film
programme.desc: Odrastanje je priča o odrastanju tri skateboard prijatelja u njihovom rodnom mjestu Rust Belt koji je već godinama pogođen recesijom. Pokušavajući razumijeti zašto su on i njegovi prijatelji pobjegli iz rodnog grada kada su bili mladi, redatelj Bing Liu prati 23-godišnjeg Zacka koji upravo postaje otac te 17-godišnjeg Keira koja se zapošljava po prvi puta. Dok se film razvija, Bing Liu naći će se usred Zackove burne veze sa djevojkom i Keirove unutrašnje borbe sa svojim rasnim identitetom te sa smrću oca.

programme.title: Liza Minnelli: Apsolutno nevjerojatna istinita priča
programme.desc: Redatelj: Bruce David Klein Trajanje: 104min Uloge: Liza Minnelli, Peter Allen, Charles Aznavour Sinopsis Liza Minnelli kći je redatelja Vincentea Minnellija i filmske ikone Judy Garland. Gledajući na svoja najranija sjećanja kroz formativne godine, Liza se suočava s teškim pitanjima i nevjerojatno visokim očekivanjima od strane kritičara, novinara i javnosti. Može li pjevati i plesati kao njezina majka? Ima li pravi "izgled" za biti zvijezda? Može li glumiti? „Liza Minnelli: Apsolutno nevjerojatna istinita priča otkriva što se dogodilo nakon toga, donoseći u fokus složen period Lizinog života 1970-ih, odmah nakon tragične smrti njezine majke, dok se Liza suočava s nizoom osobnih i profesionalnih izazova na putu prema tome da postane prava legenda. Liza je osvojila svijet filmovima (Cabaret, New York, New York, Arthur), televizijskim specijalima (Liza with a Z), koncertima (Carnegie Hall, Radio City), te brodvejskim predstavama (The Act, Chicago, Liza’s at the Palace). Njezin utjecaj proširuje se na modu, noćni život, umjetnost i kulturu. Usput, Liza je osvojila Oscara, Emmy, četiri Tonya, Grammy - te neosporni status živuće legende.

programme.title: Liam Gallagher osobno, glazbeno-dokumentarni film
programme.desc: Iskrena i emotivna priča o tome kako je jedan od najuzbudljivijih frontmena rock'n'rolla od vrtoglavih visina u vrijeme hitova grupe Oasis poput Champagne Supernove došao na loš glas i spao na život prepun ogorčenosti i pravnih bitki. Počevši ispočetka sâm, Liam riskira sve kako bi ostvario najveći rock'n'roll povratak svih vremena. Redatelji Charlie Lightening i Gavin Fitzgerald pozivaju nas u iza pozornice kako bismo bez restrikcija dobili uvid u život jednog od najpopularnijih i najkarizmatičnijih umjetnika njegove generacije.

programme.title: Putovanje jednog soba, film
programme.desc: Upoznajte Ailoa, novorođenog soba koji se upušta na nevjerojatno odiseju uz pomoć svoje majke. U naraciji velikog holivudskog glumca Donalda Sutherlanda te postavljen u pozadinu smrznutog kraljevstva sjeverne Finske, njihovo putovanje nevjerojatna je priča u kojoj će uživati cijela obitelj.

programme.title: Little Richard: Ja sam sve, glazbeno-dokumentarni film
programme.desc: Dokumentarni film Lise Cortés, prikazan na otvorenju Sundance festivala, donosi priču o crnačkim queer korijenima rock 'n' rolla, koji su uzdrmali bjelačko orijentirani kanon američke pop glazbe i tu otkrivamo inovatora i začetnika - Richarda Pennimana. Film nam uz bogatstvo arhivskih snimki i izvedbi približava njegov zamršeni intimni svijet te donosi životnu priču legende, sa svim njezinim usponima i padovima i svim proturječjima. Uz intervjue s obitelji, glazbenicima i cijenjenim istraživačima crnačke i queer tematike, ovaj dokumentarac otkriva kako je Richard izražavanje vlastite osobnosti pretvorio u umjetnost, a da pritom sebi nije mogao pružiti ono što je davao svijetu. Tijekom svog života Richard je poput sjajne, a napukle kuglice flipera poskakivao između Boga, seksa i rock 'n' rolla. Svijet ga je pokušavao ugurati u određene okvire, no Richard je bio sveprisutno biće koje je u sebi sadržavalo mnogošto - i on je bez stida bio sve.
